children: According to Wallstreetcn, a federal judge in Rhode Island ruled on Friday that the Trump administration illegally ended a $7 billion solar grant program. The Environmental Protection Agency canceled the Solar for All program last August after funds had already been allocated nationwide to help low-income communities invest in solar power and other home upgrades, and the move was immediately challenged in court by stakeholders in multiple states.

title: U.S. Federal Judge Rules Trump Administration Illegally Ended $7 Billion Solar Grant Program
